snippet.title: Noodle Cable - Trailer
snippet.description:
The Noodle Cable Technologies welcome you in their company. Untangle and plug huge cables in room-sized puzzles and witness mind-altering surrealist environments.

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4646650/Noodle_Cable/
